column1: # Library of Ruina (Switch, update 1.0.3 = v262144). Plays on the Mac; reported working on an iPhone.
# Unity 2021.3.19f1 IL2CPP, FMOD, SDK 15.3.2, NVN. subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# NPDM: 16 MB of system resource, virtual address memory. No heap is set in the Mac check.
# Unity's thread pool grows with load: 12 workers of 8 MB each on an iPhone 13 Pro Max against 2 on
# the Mac, and a 256 MB stack region then has no place for a stack ([Memory](README.md#memory)).
